actual.input: Your GIF or videoStart overPauseLive view0:00 / 0:06Play back the recordingSave the recordingCancel the depthSplatsSharp pictureSharp picture: the picture at its full size on a 3D relief, so small text stays readable. Splats: the picture rebuilt from splats.Open a GIF or video…Big Buck Bunny (a six-second scene): 6.0 s, 96 frames (16 a second)Open a GIF or a video. A clip up to 8 seconds is read whole on this device, at its own speed and up to 24 frames a second (fewer on a phone), and the depth model (about 27 MB, loaded the first time) works out how near each part of every frame is. A longer video plays whole: its depth is worked out a few times a second, in order, and it plays as that goes, with a line saying how long is left (a long video takes a while, longer on a phone). A GIF plays its first 8 seconds. It plays back in 3D, a video with its own sound. Nothing is uploaded. Tap to pause or play.

A clip up to 8 seconds is read whole on this device, at its own speed and up to 24 frames a second (fewer on a phone), and the depth model (about 27 MB, loaded the first time) works out how near each part of every frame is.
